title: Minimum Array Length After Pair Removals
description:
Given an integer array num sorted in non-decreasing order. 
 
 You can perform the following operation any number of times: 

 Choose two indices, i and j , where nums[i] < nums[j] . 
 
 Then, remove the elements at indices i and j from nums . The remaining elements retain their original order, and the array is re-indexed. 

 Return the minimum length of nums after applying the operation zero or more times. 

 Example 1: 

 Input: nums = [1,2,3,4] 
 
 Output: 0 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/05/18/tcase1.gif] 

 Example 2: 

 Input: nums = [1,1,2,2,3,3] 
 
 Output: 0 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/05/19/tcase2.gif] 

 Example 3: 

 Input: nums = [1000000000,1000000000] 
 
 Output: 2 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 Since both numbers are equal, they cannot be removed. 

 Example 4: 

 Input: nums = [2,3,4,4,4] 
 
 Output: 1 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/05/19/tcase3.gif] 

 Constraints: 

 1 <= nums.length <= 10 5 
 
 1 <= nums[i] <= 10 9 
 
 nums is sorted in non-decreasing order.
